testedVersions: Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.10068 and PowerShell 7.6.10 Windows, Pester 5.7.1; mocked GroupPolicy 1.0.0.0 and ActiveDirectory 1.0.1.0 shapes
Linux CI synthetic tests only; not a supported live execution OS
prerequisites: Windows with RSAT Group Policy Management and AD DS tools, domain/DC and SYSVOL connectivity
Native Windows PowerShell 5.1; GroupPolicy 1.0.0.0 and ActiveDirectory 1.0.1.0. PowerShell 7 compatibility proxies are not supported for live collection.
An already authorized local Windows identity; no automatic installation, login, credentials or execution-policy changes
limits: Synthetic validation only; real RSAT/domain connectivity, ACLs and Office ADMX versions require an operator pilot
No AD user/computer/group inventory, effective policy, RSoP, contents, credentials, raw reports or full security descriptors
Visibility warnings prevent absence inference from ACL-filtered listings; each section preserves the exact requested scope

permissions: Read domain/forest metadata; List Contents and Read Property on the requested OU subtree and GPO containers; GPO Read including SYSVOL policy files. Domain Admin is not required.
sections.refreshStrategy: Full readable domain GPO list, or distinct GPOs directly linked to the requested OU and descendants; never infer forest-wide absence.
limits: Id is the stable ad.gpoId; DisplayName, DomainName, GpoStatus, CreationTime, ModificationTime and WmiFilter presence only
OU scope excludes inherited, domain/site and out-of-subtree links; WMI filter presence is not its evaluation

permissions: Read domain/forest metadata; List Contents and Read Property on the requested OU subtree including objectGUID, distinguishedName, gPLink and gPOptions.
sections.refreshStrategy: Read direct links for each readable OU in the exact domain/OU subtree; preserve successful links when another OU fails.
limits: GpoLinks only, never InheritedGpoLinks; GpoId, Target, Enabled, Enforced, Order, Path and GpoInheritanceBlocked are read
Typed ad.objectGUID OU references remain pending until the separate AD family supplies the object
No domain/site links, computed application order, computer containment inventory or effective policy

permissions: GPO Read and READ_CONTROL to inspect its permission summaries, plus the policy-selection metadata reads; no Modify Security, Apply Group Policy or administrator membership is required for collection.
sections.refreshStrategy: Read each selected GPO's permission summaries; retain distinct apply-filter and other-permission edges by SID.
limits: Reads Trustee.Sid, Trustee.SidType, Permission and Inherited; GpoApply produces gpoSecurityFilter, all other supported summaries gpoPermission
Custom permissions make coverage partial; deny ACEs, nested groups, WMI, loopback and computer policy application are not evaluated
Group, user, computer and unknown typed SID references can remain pending; no name-based match or membership enumeration

permissions: GPO Read in AD and read access to its SYSVOL registry policy files, plus the policy-selection metadata reads.
sections.refreshStrategy: Read the three exact user policy keys; publish only DWORD VBAWarnings and blockcontentexecutionfrominternet with Set/Delete state.
limits: Six Office 16.0 ADMX-backed macro policy values only; no arbitrary registry values, template contents or localized ADMX names
Reads FullKeyPath, ValueName, HasValue, PolicyState, Type and Value; Delete retains null integerValue and is not an inventory deletion
Any missing-key, access, connectivity or unsupported-shape error reduces coverage; missing-key errors are not silently reclassified as not configured
Office Cloud Policy, Intune, preferences, machine settings and other Office versions are excluded; registry policy is not effective policy on a computer
